description: Refresh one case from the court case summary and return the dates the court has on file (filed, last filing, converted, plan confirmed, discharged, dismissed, terminated, closed). Identifies the case by simpleName. Pass simple_name or a case number (with court when the number is reused). This calls the court, so use it for one case at a time. Single Case plan: monitored cases only. Subscribers only.

case_number.description: 7-digit short case number alternative to simple_name.

court.description: Court name as returned in the court field, for example "Delaware" or "Texas Southern".

court_state.description: 2-letter state. Matches every district in that state.

name: case_status
